name: Machine Seated Single-Arm Row
steps: Sit facing the chest pad on a row machine with independent handles and take one handle.
Steady yourself with the free hand and let your working shoulder blade glide forward as the arm straightens.
Pull the handle smoothly back toward your ribs by driving your elbow behind you and squeezing your lat and mid-back.
Extend your arm slowly back to the start, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep both shoulders square to the chest pad rather than twisting open to heave the handle back.
Maintain a neutral wrist and pull smoothly without jerking the weight.
